result.reason: Deleting Section 2.2 fully removes the sole-supplier and exclusivity obligations and therefore achieves the preferred position. It also satisfies the fallback as a more protective result: because no exclusivity exists, the fallback limitations and automatic-ending conditions do not need to operate. The edit is confined to the offending clause and introduces no contradiction or unrelated obligation.
